sentence: The room's calls, building, upkeep, move, neighbour deals, and close restate in the model's terms, but t06's finding-a-community and t08's tracing of changed colours carry organizing the model lacks.

The room's organizing restates in the model's terms — calls for hands and the rally to keep the U (t01, t02), the move to a new spot when space is taken (t03), border talk and help with r/fireemblem and neighbours (t04), and celebrating and saving the surviving U (t07) — but themes t06 and t08 with concepts c0030, c0009, c0010 and c0042 carry organizing the model lacks, since the mark draws a community back into the room and members work out who changed their work and why, which the model stops short of.
